name: University of Liverpool

facts.text: The University of Liverpool has been 'advancing learning and transforming lives since 1881', is the original redbrick university and a founding member of the Russell Group.
Liverpool's city-centre campus address is Foundation Building, Brownlow Hill, Liverpool L69 7ZX.
Liverpool is in the top 140 in the QS World University Rankings 2027 and 18th in The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2026.
Liverpool's teaching is rated Gold by the Teaching Excellence Framework, and 91% of its research is ranked world leading or internationally excellent (REF 2021).
International students joining a master's course at Liverpool must pay a £2,000 deposit before the deadline; no deposit is required for undergraduate or postgraduate research degrees.
